taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 127 | 0.822 | 0.822
2 | 50.4 | 5.63 | 6.45
3 | 126 | 21.2 | 27.7
4 | 149 | 29.7 | 57.3
5 | 197 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as K-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: K-type
Aquifer depth: 27.7 – 57.3 m
Recommendation: Target the resistive 149 ohm‑m horizon between ~28 m and ~57 m depth for well screening, and case off the overlying conductive 50.4 ohm‑m clay/silt layer (6.45–27.7 m) to prevent sediment influx and ensure a stable borehole.
